Blur.Hint: Blurs the scene behind the dialogue overlay.

Typewriter.Name: Typewriter effect
Typewriter.Hint: Reveals lines letter by letter (Space/Enter or click to show everything).

journal.label: Dialogue journal
journal.hint: Journal holding the “Dialogue node” pages. The dialogue starts on the first of them. Players need Observer permission on it.

speaker.label: NPC name
speaker.hint: Shown above the lines. Empty = region name.

MacroBehavior.Hint: Makes the region clickable: a click runs the chosen macro on the clicking user's client — even without permission on the macro (no token needed). The macro runs with the player's rights: whatever they can't modify stays out of the script's reach.

macro.label: Macro to run
macro.hint: Drag and drop the macro (script or chat). It runs on the clicking user's client, permission or not. In a script macro: scope.behavior and scope.region give the context.

label.label: Hover label
label.hint: Shown above the region on hover. Empty = region name.

highlight.label: Highlight
highlight.hint: How to signal the clickable area to players.

speaker.label: NPC name (this node)
speaker.hint: Empty = name configured on the region.

portrait.label: Portrait (this node)
portrait.hint: Empty = portrait configured on the region. Handy for a change of expression.

condition.label: Entry condition
condition.hint: When the dialogue opens, the first node (in page order) whose condition passes becomes the start node — same syntax as choice conditions (visited:ID, variable, !variable). Empty = always eligible. Example: a “Welcome back” node with visited:ID placed BEFORE the normal intro changes the intro from the second visit on.

Page.StartHint: First candidate start node. The dialogue starts on the first node (in page order) whose entry condition passes.
Page.PlayHint: Opens the dialogue starting on this node (with your character).
Page.ChoicesHint: In display order. Empty “Leads to” = this choice ends the dialogue. With no choice at all, a “Take your leave” button is offered.
Page.NoChoices: No choice: this node ends the dialogue.

Help.Title: Help: placeholders, conditions, variables
Help.Body:
Placeholders (in the line and the replies): {name} full name, {firstname}, {lastname}, {title} (Mister/Madam), {masculine|feminine} e.g. {he|she}, and {m|f|neutral} for a 3rd form when gender is unknown. Gender comes from the sheet's “Sex” field.

Condition (the choice only shows if all hold, comma-separated): key variable set, !key not set, visited:ID / !visited:ID the node with page id ID was already seen.

Sets (applied when the choice is clicked): key sets the variable, !key clears it. Variables and history are stored in the player's actor flags (flags.coc7-dialogues).

Entry condition (node field): on open, the first node whose condition passes is the start node — enough to change the intro on a return visit (“Welcome back” with visited:ID placed before the normal intro).

Expected word: the choice opens a text prompt (password…). Right answer → “Leads to”, wrong → “On failure” (empty = retry). Case and accents ignored; several answers separated by |.

Cost: charged through CoC7 Ledger in the order Spending Level → Cash → Capital (all or nothing). Cannot pay → “On failure” (empty = nothing happens). The payment is traced in chat.

Skill check: name of a sheet skill, a characteristic (STR, DEX, POW…), Luck or SAN + difficulty (Regular = value, Hard = half, Extreme = fifth). Rolled after any payment; 1 = critical, 96-100 (100 if value ≥ 50) = fumble. Success → “Leads to”, failure → “On failure” (empty: the NPC ends the exchange). The result shows in the dialogue and the d100 goes to chat. “Sets” only applies on success.

Quest (requires Simple Quest): give:UUID copies the template quest into the player's quest log (auto-created “Quêtes — Name” when possible, else created by the Keeper with the player as owner); status:UUID|done/failed/progress/hidden; objective:UUID|text|done/undone/failed. The UUID is always the template page's. Several directives separated by ;. Applied only when the choice succeeds (word, payment, roll).

SAN roll: success loss/failure loss format (e.g. 0/1d4) — d100 vs SAN, loss applied through the system. Failure → “On failure” when set, else the conversation carries on.

Items: condition item:Name/!item:Name; directives take:Name (remove) and give:Name or UUID (receive), applied on success.

Page.AnswerHint: Expected word: when set, clicking this choice opens a text prompt. Right answer (case/accents ignored) → “Leads to”; wrong → “On failure” (or retry if empty). Several accepted answers: separate with | or comma.
Page.CostHint: Cost in dollars, charged through CoC7 Ledger: Spending Level, then Cash, then Capital. Not enough money → “On failure” (or the choice does nothing). 0 = free.
Page.FailTargetHint: Node reached when the word is wrong, the player cannot pay, or the roll fails. Empty: wrong answer = retry, failed payment = nothing, failed roll = the dialogue closes.
Page.CheckHint: CoC7 check (after any payment): name of a sheet skill, a characteristic (STR, DEX, POW…), Luck or SAN, accents ignored. Success → “Leads to”; failure → “On failure” (empty: the dialogue closes). The d100 shows in chat.
Page.QuestHint: Simple Quest directives applied on success, separated by “;”: give:UUID (grants the template quest — copied into the player's OWN quest log, status In Progress), status:UUID|done (also failed, progress, hidden), objective:UUID|objective text|done (also undone, failed). UUID = right-click the template quest page → Copy UUID.
Page.SanHint: Sanity roll with loss, “success/failure” format (e.g. 0/1d4): d100 vs current SAN, the matching formula is deducted through the CoC7 system (bounds, pulp rule). Unlike a skill check, a failed SAN roll does NOT close the dialogue: it branches to “On failure” when set, else the conversation carries on. Roll and loss show in chat.
Page.ItemsHint: Inventory directives applied on success, separated by “;”: take:Name (removes 1 — hand the quest item to the NPC), give:Name or UUID (adds a copy of a world/compendium item). As a choice condition: item:Name / !item:Name shows the choice only when the item is (or isn't) carried.

Info.ResyncDone: 🎷 Music resynced for the whole table — the Keeper's playlist resumes.
Info.ResyncSilence: 🎷 Local music cut for the whole table (no Keeper playlist playing).
Info.JukeboxOffResumed: 🎷 Jukebox off — the Keeper's music resumes.

SceneBehavior.Hint: Makes the region clickable: a click takes the clicking user to the chosen scene (no token needed — a door, a staircase, a city map…). Players can reach it even if the scene isn't in the navigation bar.

activateForAll.label: Activate for the whole table (Keeper)
activateForAll.hint: When the Keeper clicks: activates the scene for every player instead of viewing it alone. No effect for a player.

highlight.label: Highlight
highlight.hint: How to signal the clickable area to players.

JukeboxBehavior.Hint: Makes the region clickable: a click starts (or stops) a local jukebox on the chosen playlist for the clicking user. It cuts their music (Music channel only — not environment nor interface) and plays on the Interface channel, adjustable with their Interface slider. No Keeper needed; the Keeper can see who listens to what and cut everything.

playlist.label: Playlist
playlist.hint: Drag and drop the playlist. Its mode (sequential, shuffle, simultaneous) and per-track loops are honored.

highlight.hint: How to signal the clickable area to players.
